I could not find a complete answer. Only part of it is confirmed.

Confirmed: the issue-triage loop is ON when `settings.issue_triage.enabled` is absent. Turning it off makes the sweep skip the repo, and the needs-triage label then starts nothing.

Probably also on: a spec says the Spec tickets pill on the Loops tab is switched on by default for existing repositories (FR14). This is weaker evidence.

Not established: the defaults for the implementation, code review, auto merge and spec upkeep loops, and for the digest. Each of these has an On/Off switch on the Loops tab, resolved through `loopEnabled(key, settings)` in `libs/shared/src/domain/loops`. I did not find that function's body, so I do not know what it returns when a setting is missing. The one default I saw for auto merge is that `auto_merge.approver` defaults to `none`. Auto merge also has a third 'needs setup' state.
sources: episode memory (session:re-cinq/lore): FR14 Spec tickets pill on by default for existing repos

judgements.reason: The answer correctly identifies triage as on and spec tickets as probably on, but leaves spec upkeep and all the off-by-default loops (implementation, code review, auto-merge, digest) undetermined without contradicting the gold.
